{{Quote|Some former Czerka exec, Samovan Bann&mdash;he wants to revamp Black Sun into a galactic franchise. People working for him are brutal.|Tam Daral|<ref name="BC">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Bounty Contract: Coruscant|Ord Mantell}}</ref>}}
'''Samovan Bann''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as an executive of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the time of the [[Galactic War]], Bann had decided to take over the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and turn it into a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] franchise, and under his rule the gang become extremely violent. As a result, a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] named [[Tam Daral]] enlisted the services of the [[Bounty Brokers Association]], and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] he hired tracked down Bann's lieutenants before locating Bann himself and bringing him to justice.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samovan Bann is the Kingpin Bounty for the planet Coruscant in Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event that first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Players can either capture Bann with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] or [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, so this article refrains from assuming a definitive outcome.<ref name="TOR" />
